bodies.name: Lagos State Citizens' Mediation Centre (now Citizens' Mediation Bureau, CMB)
bodies.role: Free mediation of landlord–tenant disputes; no lawyer required. The Tenancy Law itself directs courts to promote mediation and amicable settlement (s.32; cl.36).
bring: Proof of rent payment (receipts or transfers)
Your tenancy agreement, if you have one
Any notice or letter your landlord served you
Recent utility bills for the premises

offices.address: 7 LJ Dosunmu Street, opposite Beehive School, CBD, Alausa-Ikeja
201 Herbert Macaulay Road, opposite Police Station, Adekunle
22 Oyetayo Street, beside the Marriage Registry, Oshodi

bodies.contact_note: Two official MoJ sites list different details; the newer site (lagosstatemoj.org, 'Citizens' Mediation Bureau') carries current mobile numbers and named office heads and is used here. The older site (lagosministryofjustice.org) still lists superseded addresses and 01- landlines. Email: cmcikeja01@gmail.com · Hotline: 08118161620

bodies.name: LASRERA (Lagos State Real Estate Regulatory Authority)
bodies.role: Registers estate agents and takes complaints against them. Check registration before paying any agent fee.
bring: The agent's name and, if known, registration details
Evidence of the fee demanded or paid (message, receipt, transfer)
bodies.contact_note: Official domain lasrera.lagosstate.gov.ng has no DNS record as of 2026-09-17 (checked from two networks; spelling matches LASRERA's own search-indexed URLs, so this is an outage, not a typo). URLs kept for when it returns; phone numbers omitted until verifiable from an official page.

bodies.name: Magistrate Court (of the division where the premises are)
bodies.role: Hears recovery-of-premises proceedings. Only a court order can lawfully put a tenant out — self-help eviction is an offence (s.44; cl.43).
bring: Proof of rent payment and updated utility bills
Tenancy agreement and all notices served or received
Your incident record, if there was a lock-out or threat

bodies.name: Small Claims Court (at the Magistrate Court)
bodies.role: Fast track for recovering money — an overcharged fee, a withheld deposit, a refund — up to ₦5,000,000, designed for individuals without a lawyer.
bring: Evidence of the payment (receipt, transfer, messages)
A written demand you sent first (a Letter of Demand is required before filing)
The other party's name and address
